Hello Learner. Today, we will talk about Present Continuous Tense . Learner, what are you doing right now? What are you doing right now? - Did you say you are sitting down? - Can you say I am sitting down? - Well done Learner. That is Present Continuous Tense . Present continuous tense is used to show an action is still going on at the time of speaking. Present continuous tense is used to show an action is still going on at the time of speaking. Learner, look at the sentences you have written. One. My name is Goat. It is positive. My name is not sheep. That sentence is negative. Number two. We are dogs. That is a positive sentence. We are not wild animals. That is a negative sentence. Number three. I have wings. That is positive. But I do not have horns. That is negative. And number four. I can eat grass. Positive.
